responsibility: This installed header is the public entry point for the AArch64 SVE ACLE interface. Rather than spelling out all types and intrinsic declarations in C, it provides the required scalar typedefs and includes arm_bf16.h, then uses #pragma GCC aarch64 "arm_sve.h" to ask the compiler’s SVE builtin framework to inject the SVE types and intrinsic declarations directly, making it the user-facing trigger for compiler-generated SVE API exposure.
